articles.title: "Targeting ships in international waterways unacceptable," says India as IMO condemns attacks on vessels in Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Indian High Commissioner Vikram Doraiswamy emphasized India's commitment to maritime security, freedom of navigation, and safeguarding global trade at the IMO. He highlighted the Indian Navy's proactive role in counter-piracy and addressing Red Sea threats. This reinforces India's growing capability as a significant net security provider, ensuring safe international shipping and promoting regional stability.

articles.title: Watch how Indian Army converted an old bridge into a stunning 'Border Brew Cafe' near Arunachal border
articles.summary: The Indian Army has implemented a scenic transformation, creating a vistadome-like facility offering hot brews and mountain views. This initiative, generating buzz among locals and defence enthusiasts, showcases the Army's innovative efforts to enhance welfare or public engagement in picturesque regions. Aspirants should note such projects reflect the forces' multi-faceted role beyond combat.
